name: Memory (TencentDB)
description: Four-layer memory system — auto-captures, structures, and profiles conversational knowledge

mode.description: OpenClaw integration mode: local/function (default, runs in a local process, using OpenClaw function/host LLM runner) or client/gateway/remote (lightweight client mode, connecting to an external Memory Gateway)

storeBackend.description: Storage backend: sqlite (local SQLite + sqlite-vec) or tcvdb (Tencent Cloud vector database). Only effective in local/function mode

server.description: External Memory Gateway connection configuration in client/gateway/remote mode

enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic conversation capture

excludeAgents.description: List of excluded Agent glob patterns (e.g., bench-judge-*). Agents that match will not be captured, recalled, or involved in pipeline scheduling

l0l1RetentionDays.description: Local file retention days for L0/L1 (unit: days). 0 = no cleanup; if non-zero, the default must be >=3. If 1 or 2, allowAggressiveCleanup must be explicitly enabled

allowAggressiveCleanup.description: Whether to allow high-risk cleanup configurations (l0l1RetentionDays=1 or 2)

enableDedup.description: L1 intelligent deduplication (conflict detection based on vector similarity or keywords)

maxMemoriesPerSession.description: Maximum number of memory entries per session for a single L1 extraction

model.description: Model used for extraction (format: provider/model); if not filled in, the openclaw default model is used

persona.description: Scenario summarization and user profile settings (L2/L3)

triggerEveryN.description: Trigger persona generation every N new memories

backupCount.description: Number of persona backups to retain

sceneBackupCount.description: Number of scene block backups to retain

model.description: Persona generation model (format: provider/model); uses the openclaw default model if not specified

everyNConversations.description: Trigger L1 batch processing every N conversations

enableWarmup.description: Warm-up mode: a new session starts triggering from 1 conversation, doubling after each L1 (1→2→4→...→everyN) to accelerate early memory extraction

l1IdleTimeoutSeconds.description: L1 idle timeout (seconds): how long after the user stops conversing to trigger L1 batch processing

l2DelayAfterL1Seconds.description: Delay (seconds) after L1 completes before triggering L2

l2MinIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum interval (seconds) between two L2 extractions in the same session

l2MaxIntervalSeconds.description: Maximum polling interval (seconds) for L2 in the same active session

sessionActiveWindowHours.description: session active window (hours), sessions inactive for longer than this time stop L2 polling

maxCharsPerMemory.description: Maximum number of characters per single L1 memory injection; 0 means no limit

maxTotalRecallChars.description: Total character budget for L1 memory injection in this round of auto-recall; 0 means no limit

strategy.description: Search strategy: keyword (keyword), embedding (vector), hybrid (hybrid RRF fusion, recommended)

timeoutMs.description: Overall recall timeout (milliseconds); skips memory injection and prints a warning log after timeout

enabled.description: Whether vector search is enabled (it will actually be disabled if provider=none)

provider.description: Embedding service provider: enter the name of a remote service compatible with the OpenAI API (e.g., openai, deepseek, etc.); leaving it blank or setting it to none disables vector search

proxyUrl.description: Local proxy address (required only when provider=qclaw). After configuration, embedding requests will be forwarded through this proxy, and the original baseUrl will be passed as the Remote-URL header

baseUrl.description: API Base URL (required): enter the API address of the corresponding provider

dimensions.description: Vector dimension (required, must match the selected model)

sendDimensions.description: Whether to include the dimensions field in the request body. Defaults to true (compatible with OpenAI text-embedding-3-* Matryoshka truncation). When the target service is a fixed-dimension model that does not support custom dimensions, such as BGE-M3, set this to false, otherwise the server will reject the request with HTTP 400 ('does not support matryoshka representation').

conflictRecallTopK.description: Top-K number for recall during conflict detection

maxInputChars.description: Maximum number of characters for embedding input text. If exceeded, it will be truncated and a warning log will be printed (default 5000, suitable for the token limit of most models)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout (in milliseconds) for a single embedding API call. The request will be aborted on timeout and will not be retried

recallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (in milliseconds) for embedding in the recall path, overriding timeoutMs. When the user is waiting, it is recommended to set it shorter (e.g., 3000)

captureTimeoutMs.description: capture path embedding timeout (milliseconds), overrides timeoutMs. Runs in the background, can be set longer (e.g. 15000)

tcvdb.description: Tencent Cloud Vector Database configuration (effective only when storeBackend=tcvdb)

database.description: Database name (auto-generated based on instance ID if not filled in)

alias.description: User-friendly alias (optional, used for identification in database.json)

caPemPath.description: CA certificate PEM file path (used for HTTPS connections)

bm25.description: BM25 sparse vector encoding settings (mainly for the tcvdb backend)

enabled.description: Whether to enable BM25 sparse vector encoding
Whether to enable metric reporting (via Gateway log output of structured METRIC JSON)

type.description: Reporting method: local means outputting structured JSON logs through the logger

llm.description: Independent LLM configuration — When enabled, L1/L2/L3 extraction bypasses OpenClaw's built-in models and calls the specified OpenAI-compatible API directly. Disabled by default (uses OpenClaw's host model).

enabled.description: Whether to enable the standalone LLM mode. When disabled, the OpenClaw host model is used.

stream.description: Whether to call the upstream with a streaming request (streamText). Default false (non-streaming). Set to true only for OpenAI-compatible upstreams that accept only streaming requests. Effective only when the standalone LLM (llm.enabled=true) is enabled; otherwise the OpenClaw host runner is used and this switch is ignored.

offload.description: Context Offload Settings — Multi-layer context compression system (independent toggle, disabled by default). Supports local (local LLM processing) and client (reuses server.url remote service) modes

enabled.description: Whether to enable Context Offload (disabled by default, does not affect Memory functionality)

mode.description: Offload run mode: local (process locally with LLM), backend (use the remote v1 service via backendUrl), client (reuse the remote offload v2 service via server.url), collect (data collection only, no compression). If not set, it is automatically derived: if backendUrl exists → backend, if server.url exists → client, otherwise → local

model.description: 【local mode】LLM model used by Offload (format: provider/model); if not filled in, uses the openclaw default model

stream.description: 【Only effective when mode=local】Whether to call the upstream via a streaming request (streamText). Default is false (non-streaming). Some OpenAI-compatible upstreams that only accept streaming requests need to be set to true. In backend/client/collect modes, the remote offload server handles the calls, and this switch is ignored.

forceTriggerThreshold.description: 【local mode】Number of accumulated tool pairs after which L1 is forced to trigger

maxPairsPerBatch.description: 【local mode】Max tool pairs per batch for L1

l2NullThreshold.description: 【local mode】Trigger L2 when the count of node_id=null in offload.jsonl reaches this threshold

l2TimeoutSeconds.description: 【local mode】Trigger L2 if more than this many seconds have passed since the last L2

mildOffloadRatio.description: Mild compression trigger ratio (as a proportion of the context window)

compactionRatio.description: 【client mode】Trigger compaction when context ratio exceeds this threshold (0-1), reuse server.url as the backend address

backendUrl.description: 【Deprecated, please use mode=client】Backend service URL, routes L1/L1.5/L2/L4 to the backend after configuration
